corrections.reason: The printed characters are clearly 2nd order 'ሁ' (ሁነ ... ባልሁነ) rather than 7th order 'ሆ'.
The printed glyph at the beginning of the line is 2nd order 'ሁ' (እየሁኑ), matching the archaic Andemta form.
Both visually and grammatically in Amharic Andemta, the converb is 'ተርጕመህ' (having interpreted it, parallel to 'ገልጸህ'), not the noun 'ትርጕሙህ'.
The printed Ge'ez text has the plural 'ወዓፀድትኒ' (and the reapers, Matt 13:39); the 'ት' before 'ኒ' was omitted in Pass 1.
